subject: journey/nautilus
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 3:2 illustration for the historical atlas sketchbook of Jules Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. A nineteenth-century naturalist's field sketch in graphite and sepia pen with restrained transparent watercolour washes on warm ivory paper. Fine irregular parallel hatching, economical contour lines, a few details sharply observed; leave areas of cream paper around irregular unfinished edges. One coherent scene that reads at small sizes. No captions, labels, border, binding, signatures, photorealism, modern equipment, or Disney submarine designs. A lone Tamil pearl diver with a waistcloth, seen underwater in profile, reaches for a small oyster on a shallow bank. Woven collecting bag at his waist and weighted line descending from a little boat above. Dappled sunlight across the sand. No helmet on the pearl diver, no sharks.
